description: Analyse an Austrian residential property as a rental investment: acquisition costs, annuity loan payment, monthly cash flow before and after income tax, gross and net yield, cash-on-cash return, debt cover (DSCR), break-even rent, whether statutory rent caps (MRG) apply and the Richtwert cap, depreciation (AfA) with the legal land share, a 25-year Liebhaberei check, and risk flags. Use when evaluating whether a specific flat or house is a good buy-to-let deal. Inputs in EUR; rents and owner costs are monthly and net of VAT. Pass what you know: missing facts fall back to documented assumptions and are flagged. The JSON is compact by default (key figures, flags, citations); pass detail "full" for every line, the tax years and the rules used. Not covered: rent increases or interest-rate changes over time, tax credits, Richtwert surcharges and deductions (Zuschläge/Abschläge).

assumptions.description: Override default assumptions. Omit to use documented defaults.

contractFeePct.description: Lawyer/notary contract and escrow fee, % of price excl. VAT. Default 1.5 (typical range 1–3).

grundbuchApplications.description: Number of separate land-register applications. Default 1.

grundbuchFiling.description: How the land-register application is filed. Default "electronic" (lawyer or notary).

maintenancePctPerYear.description: Owner's maintenance, % per year of price plus acquisition costs. Default 0.2.

managementPct.description: Letting/management fees paid by the owner, % of net cold rent. Default 0 (self-managed).

marginalTaxRatePct.description: Owner's marginal income tax rate in %, applied to the rental result. Default 40. Ignored when tax.otherTaxableIncome is given.

mortgageRegistrationFactor.description: Registered mortgage as a multiple of the loan. Default 1.3.

vacancyPct.description: Vacancy and rent loss, % of gross rent (rent + operating costs). Default 4.

commissionPct.description: Buyer's broker commission in % of the price, EXCLUDING 20% VAT. Listings often say '3% zzgl. 20% USt' → 3.

sellerPaysCommission.description: Whether the seller also pays the broker. Affects the legal cap. Omit if unknown.

broker.description: Broker commission, or "none" if the purchase is commission-free (provisionsfrei).

detail.description: How much of the result to return as JSON. "summary" (default) keeps the key figures, flags, assumptions, limitations and deduplicated citations (about 40% of the size for underwrite_property, 60% for estimate_acquisition_costs). "full" adds every line item with its calculation and citations, the tax years and the rules used. The readable text is the same in both.

financing.description: Mortgage financing. Omit for a cash purchase.

ratePct.description: Nominal annual interest rate in %, e.g. 3.9. Treated as fixed for the whole term.

registeredMortgageAmount.description: Mortgage amount registered in the land register, if known. Defaults to 1.3 × the loan.

termYears.description: Loan term in whole years, e.g. 25.

ownerCosts.description: Costs the owner pays that cannot be passed on to the tenant.

maintenanceMonthly.description: Monthly maintenance budget in EUR; overrides maintenancePctPerYear.

reserveFundMonthly.description: The flat's monthly repair-reserve contribution (Rücklage) in EUR. Defaults to the legal minimum per m² for condominiums.

property.description: Property facts. Pass what you know; missing facts are flagged.

buildingPermitDate.description: Date of the building permit (Baubewilligung), YYYY-MM-DD. Decides whether MRG rent caps apply.

buildingYear.description: Year the building was completed (Baujahr). Used as an estimate if the permit date is unknown.

ownership.description: condominium = Eigentumswohnung (Wohnungseigentum); house = single-family house; wholeBuilding = entire rental building.

publicFunding.description: Whether the building was built with public funds (e.g. Wohnbauförderung).

state.description: Bundesland (ä → ae, ö → oe), e.g. "wien" for Vienna, "steiermark" for Graz. Needed for the Richtwert rent cap.

unitsInBuilding.description: Number of separate flats or business units in the building.

purchasePrice.description: Purchase price in EUR (the agreed price for the property), e.g. 249000.

fixedTerm.description: Whether the lease is fixed-term (befristet). For rent-capped flats this lowers the cap by 25%. Omit if unknown.

netColdMonthly.description: Monthly net cold rent (Hauptmietzins) in EUR, excluding operating costs and VAT.

operatingCostsMonthly.description: Monthly operating costs (Betriebskosten) in EUR, passed on to the tenant.

tax.description: Facts for the income tax on rent and the depreciation (AfA). Omit to use flagged defaults (40% marginal rate, 40% land share).

averageLandPricePerM2.description: Average price of building land in the municipality, EUR per m². Under 400 in a town under 100,000 inhabitants → 20% land share.

landSharePct.description: Land share of the purchase in %, if proven (e.g. expert opinion). Otherwise presumed at 20, 30 or 40% by law.

municipalityInhabitants.description: Inhabitants of the municipality (e.g. Vienna ≈ 2,000,000). Decides the presumed land share together with the land price.

otherTaxableIncome.description: Owner's other taxable income per year in EUR (e.g. gross salary minus social security). Enables the exact income tax tariff.

valuationDate.description: Date whose rules apply, YYYY-MM-DD, usually today or the expected signing date. Defaults to today (Vienna time). Covered: 2025-04-01 to 2027-12-31.

name: underwrite_property
title: Underwrite an Austrian buy-to-let purchase
